note: Noelle's authority on what each formation template is and what it is physically allowed to do. Keyed by model_id (folder name under templates/track_formations/). structure_type is the canonical type — written to each placed instance at placement time. Noelle generates {model}.feature.json from this on every Build and Validate.

station_thru_dip.note: Two connection points. Through station. landing_chains and exit_chains defined in lines.json — model designer authority. pass_far/pass_near defined here (Noelle behavioral policy, not geometry). Updated 2026-05-31.

station_line_end.note: One connection point. End-of-line terminus. Departure requires uturn_1 + far_main + far_out to reverse direction. Arrival includes platform_parking.

station_parking.note: Single CP parking station with internal U-turn. Pods park in platform bays.

traffic_circle7.note: Traffic circle with 4 connection points (CP0–CP3). The '7' in the name is the 7m diameter, not the CP count. Pods enter on any gw_N_in arm, traverse the ring (gw_c_N_M arcs), exit on any gw_N_out arm. No passenger platform — pods do not dwell.
